extracted.intended_audience: Mathematics Stack Exchange askers and editors deciding when to use the 'soft-question' tag
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for tagging and formulating 'soft' mathematics questions on Math.SE—i.e., questions whose answers are not objectively correct/incorrect but are still on-topic for the site. Advises on relevance and specificity when asking or applying the tag.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subjectivity / objective evaluability
rubrics_metrics.description: For questions whose answers can't be objectively evaluated as correct or incorrect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this tag for questions where answers are not amenable to an objective correct/incorrect judgement (i.e., 'soft' questions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to Mathematics.SE
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions must still be relevant to this site (Mathematics Stack Exchange).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if subjective, the question should clearly relate to mathematics or mathematical practice so it remains on-topic for the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specificity / clarity of the ask
rubrics_metrics.description: Please be specific about what you are after.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When posting a soft question, state clearly what kind of answers or discussion you want (examples, intuition, references, pedagogical advice, etc.) to keep the conversation focused and useful.
